categories.description: A commentary segment indicates that the race leader changed or that a swimmer moved into the lead.
A commentary segment describes who is leading or how the lead is being maintained.
A commentary segment discusses world, Olympic, competition, or personal-record pace.
A commentary segment discusses technique, turn, underwater phase, stroke execution, or finish execution.
A commentary segment describes pursuit, closing gaps, or a swimmer challenging another swimmer.
A commentary segment describes final placement, medal result, or race outcome.
